visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair and a mauve sweatshirt sits in a brightly lit Japanese restaurant with wooden partitions. He looks directly at the camera, then crosses his forearms to form an 'X' gesture while a large bowl of white rice and a plate of sliced meat with shredded cabbage sit in the foreground. (2) The scene shifts to a red fabric banner of a ramen shop, followed by shots of a long queue of people on a city street and a close-up of a bowl of ramen with red chili sauce. The man is then shown eating noodles with chopsticks, wearing a dark jacket over his sweatshirt. (3) A vertical red sign for a beef bowl restaurant is displayed against a backdrop of modern glass buildings. A close-up shows rice being topped with thin slices of beef and a dark sauce. (4) Back in the restaurant, the man looks upward with a confused facial expression. A cartoon graphic of a stressed businessman with a dark suit and red face appears briefly over a grey background. (5) The man is seen in a busy indoor transit area, pulling a silver hardshell suitcase with one hand while looking at the camera. (6) A large grey textured suitcase stands alone in a room. The screen then displays a mobile interface for a shopping app 'Buyee', showing various items like luxury bags, traditional fans, and listings from Amazon Japan. The man's mauve sweatshirt is visible as he points at the screen. (7) Inside a crowded train carriage, passengers are seen standing close together. The man is shown wearing his black backpack on his chest, looking into the lens with a neutral expression. (8) The video returns to the man in the restaurant setting; he smiles and makes a 'thumbs up' gesture towards the camera.
